test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
One number is not like the others:

1331, 2197, 2744, 4096
solution:
Logic : **All the numbers provided are perfect cubes:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/885aba7fbfbf069cd5d77cac0e5cc19c2ed7d416dfb1ab452cc5a5b97a0b5206.png] 

So,1331, 2197, and 2744 are cubes. 4096 is a cube but also a perfect square.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
